name: refix.com.sv
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: refix.com.sv scores 80 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 40 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 6 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 6 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /fontaneria-y-destape/, /aire-acondicionado/, for example button[aria-labelledby="_R_1af5f7b_-servicio-etq"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 6 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 52 JavaScript errors while loading
fix.evidence: Blocked script execution in 'about:blank' because the document's frame is sandboxed and the 'allow-scripts' permission is not set. | Blocked script execution in 'about:blank' because the document's frame is sandboxed and the 'allow-scripts' permission is not…
fix.fix: Open the browser console on the start page and fix the errors in order.

items: Blocked script execution in 'about:blank' because the document's frame is sandboxed and the 'allow-scripts' permission is not set.
Blocked script execution in 'about:blank' because the document's frame is sandboxed and the 'allow-scripts' permission is not set.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.
